MORE:
Ventura Textiles Ltdhas informed BSE that the meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company is scheduled on 09/11/2026 ,inter alia, to consider and approve following agenda:
1) To record and approve the Un-Audited Financial Results for the Quarter and Half year ended on 30th September, 2026 along with the Limited Review Report of the Statutory Auditors thereon.
 
2) To Consider and Review Strategies, Investments and utilization of existing assets of the Company in the new business subsequent to the registration of the alteration of main object of the memorandum of association of the company. 

3) To Review status on name change application with BSE.

4) Any other matter with the permission of the chair.
